answer: Because the timing is written down against the falcon challenge, the dune audit can replay the mesa history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 168 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4612 identities would post 1865 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
